prose: The extraordinary energy worker and intrepid host of the Rogue Ways podcast returns to provide a pertinent psychological profile on the various personality types that our governments and social hierarchies have been breeding. Lindsey Scharmyn breaks down the mechanics of broken hearts that are responsible for the societal beat-downs that many of us have had to heal through, especially in the last few years. In examining the psycho/socio-pathology and how our world is engineered for the demonic to rise to the top, we can better know who we are in this neverending story, and build back better with boundaries that reinforce our personal responsibility.
